title: Biosphere Reserves as Boundary Organisations that support landscape governance: Analysing the Biosphere for Baltic network
title_zh: 生物圈保护区作为支持景观治理的边界组织：对波罗的海生物圈网络的分析
title_primary: 生物圈保护区作为支持景观治理的边界组织：对波罗的海生物圈网络的分析
title_secondary: Biosphere Reserves as Boundary Organisations that support landscape governance: Analysing the Biosphere for Baltic network
authors: Charles Westerberg, Ralph Tafon, Michael Gilek
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article analyses how Biosphere Reserves (BRs) in the Biosphere for Baltic network operate as Boundary Organisations (BOs) in support of collaborative landscape governance. Using Ostrom’s Institutional Analysis and Development framework in combination with BO theory, it examines how institutional arrangements, stakeholder interactions, and contextual conditions shape the capacity of BRs to convene, translate, collaborate, and mediate across governance levels. Based on case studies of seven BRs in the Baltic Sea region, the results show consistent patterns in how governance models, participatory processes, knowledge flows, and institutional recognition enable or constrain boundary functions. Effective convening and collaboration were most evident where long-standing relationships, strong trust, and cross-sectoral platforms were in place. Barriers arose from short-term project cycles, uneven participation, tensions around authority and role boundaries, and limited national-level uptake of BR-generated knowledge. Knowledge translation appeared stronger when BRs could connect scientific, local, and administrative perspectives and relate them to planning and management needs, while institutional misalignment made learning and follow-up more difficult. The findings underscore the need to balance institutional flexibility, neutrality, learning, and embeddedness to enhance the effectiveness of BRs as boundary organisations for advancing landscape governance.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了“波罗的海生物圈网络”中的生物圈保护区如何作为边界组织运作，以支持协作式景观治理。结合奥斯特罗姆的制度分析与发展框架与边界组织理论，探讨了制度安排、利益相关者互动及情境条件如何塑造生物圈保护区在治理层级间召集、翻译、协作与调解的能力。基于波罗的海地区七个生物圈保护区的案例研究，结果显示治理模式、参与过程、知识流动及制度认可在促进或制约边界功能方面呈现出一致规律。在长期关系、高度信任及跨部门平台已建立的地区，有效的召集与协作最为显著。障碍则源于短期项目周期、参与不均衡、权威与角色边界的张力，以及国家层面对生物圈保护区所产生知识的采纳有限。当生物圈保护区能够连接科学、地方与行政视角，并将其与规划管理需求相关联时，知识翻译能力更强；而制度错位则使学习与后续跟进更为困难。研究结果强调，需平衡制度灵活性、中立性、学习能力与嵌入性，以提升生物圈保护区作为边界组织在推进景观治理中的有效性。

title: Toward a responsibility system in China’s community carbon forestry management: A practice based on ordered polycentric governance
title_zh: 中国社区碳汇林管理中的责任体系构建：基于有序多中心治理的实践
title_primary: 中国社区碳汇林管理中的责任体系构建：基于有序多中心治理的实践
title_secondary: Toward a responsibility system in China’s community carbon forestry management: A practice based on ordered polycentric governance
authors: Bohao Jin, Yanqiang Du, Xianlei Ma
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Balancing carbon reduction and local livelihoods has remained a persistent challenge in community carbon forestry management (CCFM). Current literature is increasingly acknowledging the need to reconcile individual and collective objectives in CCFM based on Ostromian polycentricity, yet it has not identified an optimal solution. We develop a “agency relationship-motivation strategy-property rights structure-outcomes” framework to unpack the responsibility system in China’s CCFM. Within this analytical framework, we first classify three forms of principal-agent relationships alongside their matching incentive strategies. Second, we unpack the interconnections among principal-agent relationships, motivation strategies, and property rights allocation. Finally, we argue that CCFM exhibits an ordered polycentric governance structure. Further, we apply the analytical framework to the CCFM case in Shunchang, Fujian, China, and find that: (i) three types of agency relationships in CCFM, i.e., delegation, administrative commission, and civil commission, match the intensity of the three motivation strategies (political incentives, economic incentives, and intrinsic incentives). (ii) agency relationships and motivation strategies jointly shape the property rights structure, e.g., principals under delegation possess authoritative rights; agents under delegation and principals under administrative commission exercise control rights; agents under administrative and civil commission exercise use rights. (iii) the effective integration of multiple principal-agent relationships shapes the ordered polycentric governance in China’s CCFM. The delegation addresses spatial integration challenges, and responds to political promotion demands; the administrative commission tackles institutional innovation dilemmas; the civil commission copes with social network extension issues. The analysis of CCFM within the Chinese context contributes to debates on the role of rural carbon forestry management in and beyond China.
abstract_zh: 平衡碳减排与地方生计一直是社区碳汇林业管理（CCFM）中的持续挑战。现有文献日益认识到，基于奥斯特罗姆式多中心理论，在CCFM中协调个体与集体目标之必要性，然而尚未找到最优解。我们构建了一个“委托代理关系—激励策略—产权结构—结果”的分析框架，以解析中国CCFM中的责任体系。在此分析框架内，我们首先将委托代理关系划分为三种形式，并匹配相应的激励策略。其次，我们揭示委托代理关系、激励策略与产权配置之间的内在联系。最后，我们认为CCFM呈现出有序的多中心治理结构。进一步地，我们将该分析框架应用于中国福建顺昌的CCFM案例，发现：（i）CCFM中的三类代理关系，即委托、行政委托和民事委托，与三种激励策略（政治激励、经济激励和内在激励）的强度相匹配。（ii）委托代理关系与激励策略共同塑造产权结构，例如，委托关系下的委托人拥有权威性权利；委托关系下的代理人和行政委托关系下的委托人行使控制权；行政委托和民事委托关系下的代理人行使使用权。（iii）多种委托代理关系的有效整合塑造了中国CCFM中的有序多中心治理。委托关系解决了空间整合挑战，并回应了政治晋升需求；行政委托应对了制度创新困境；民事委托处理了社会网络扩展问题。在中国语境下对CCFM的分析，为国内外农村碳汇林业管理作用的讨论作出了贡献。

title: Import tariff transmission in a production network
title_zh: 生产网络中的进口关税传导
title_primary: 生产网络中的进口关税传导
title_secondary: Import tariff transmission in a production network
authors: Khalil, Makram & Strobel, Felix & Rouillard, Pierre M.
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices. JEL Classification: E23, E32, F13
abstract_zh: 我们发现，美国进口关税对美国制造业部门的影响究竟是供给侧效应还是需求侧效应，取决于受影响部门在美国生产网络中的位置。基于美国制造业部门面板数据的局部投影法分析表明，美国进口关税（包括2018-2019年的关税上调）通过两种不同渠道导致部门产出收缩：（1）关税上调对使用受关税影响部门产品作为生产投入的部门构成负向供给冲击，使其面临投入成本上升；（2）关税上调对客户部门因关税遭受负向供给冲击而缩减生产的部门构成负向需求冲击。我们证明，这些结果与一个包含生产互补性的简化生产网络模型一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明关税显著抑制了美国制造业产出，而投入产出关联在理解进口关税冲击向产出和生产者价格传导的过程中起着关键作用。JEL分类号：E23, E32, F13

title: Social Push and the Direction of Innovation
title_zh: 社会推动与创新方向
title_primary: 社会推动与创新方向
title_secondary: Social Push and the Direction of Innovation
authors: Einiö, Elias, Feng, Josh, Jaravel, Xavier
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries, and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost-of-living inequality and long-run growth.
abstract_zh: 创新职业机会的不平等对创新方向与不平等有何影响？利用美国和芬兰的新型关联数据集，我们证实创新者更倾向于开发与其自身在性别、社会经济地位及年龄方面相似的消费者更可能购买的产品。这种同质性既存在于细分产品类别内部，也跨越不同行业，且近几十年来保持稳定。通过将这一"社会推动"渠道纳入增长模型，我们估算出创新职业机会的不平等对生活成本不平等及长期增长具有显著影响。

title: Punishing Financial Crimes: The Impact of Prison Sentences on Defendants and Their Colleagues
title_zh: 惩罚金融犯罪：监禁刑期对被告及其同事的影响
title_primary: 惩罚金融犯罪：监禁刑期对被告及其同事的影响
title_secondary: Punishing Financial Crimes: The Impact of Prison Sentences on Defendants and Their Colleagues
authors: Kristiina Huttunen, Martti Kaila, David C. Macdonald, Emily Nix
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Financial crimes are costly to society but less severely punished than other nonviolent crimes. We investigate whether prison sentences reduce financial crimes. Using random assignment of judges in Finland to identify causal impacts, we find a prison sentence reduces defendant reoffending by 42.9 percentage points three years postsentencing. Given prior evidence of financial misconduct “contagion,” we also explore spillovers on colleagues. A prison sentence reduces the likelihood that a financial crime defendant’s colleagues commit crimes by 27 percentage points, suggesting broader deterrent effects of harsher punishments, but only for fraud cases. Last, we show financial crimes are not victimless crimes. (JEL K14, K22, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 金融犯罪对社会造成高昂代价，但相较于其他非暴力犯罪，其惩罚力度较轻。本文探究监禁刑罚能否减少金融犯罪。利用芬兰法官随机分配机制识别因果效应，我们发现，判决监禁使被告在判决后三年内的再犯率降低42.9个百分点。鉴于已有证据表明金融不当行为具有"传染性"，我们进一步考察了对同事的溢出效应。监禁判决使金融犯罪被告同事的犯罪概率降低27个百分点，这表明更严厉的惩罚具有更广泛的威慑效应，但该效应仅存在于欺诈案件中。最后，我们证明金融犯罪并非无受害者的犯罪。（JEL K14, K22, K41, K42）

title: Measuring Sensitive Outcomes through Ballot-Bag Surveys
title_zh: 通过投票袋调查测量敏感结果
title_primary: 通过投票袋调查测量敏感结果
title_secondary: Measuring Sensitive Outcomes through Ballot-Bag Surveys
authors: Crépon, Bruno, Elsayed, Ahmed, Gazeaud, Jules
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Prevailing methods for measuring sensitive outcomes confront researchers with an inherent bias-variance trade-off: direct questioning is prone to a sensitivity bias, while indirect methods such as list experiments are substantially less precise. We test the ballot-bag, a novel technique that relaxes this trade-off by mitigating bias in direct questioning while improving precision over indirect methods. In an experiment in Egypt, where direct questions on irregular migration are biased, ballot-bag estimates are not statistically different from those from a list experiment but exhibit significantly lower variance. Consequently, treatment effects are highly significant via the ballot-bag and not via the list experiment.
abstract_zh: 当前测量敏感结果的主流方法使研究者面临固有的偏差-方差权衡：直接提问易产生敏感性偏差，而列举实验等间接方法则精度显著不足。我们测试了"投票袋"这一新技术，该技术通过减轻直接提问中的偏差并提升间接方法的精度来缓解这一权衡。在埃及的一项实验中，针对非正规移民的直接提问存在偏差，而投票袋估计值与列举实验的结果无统计差异，但方差显著更低。因此，通过投票袋方法得出的处理效应高度显著，而列举实验则未呈现此结果。

title: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations
title_zh: 加纳大塔马利地区城市绿地转型的政治生态学：条件、驱动因素与权力关系
title_primary: 加纳大塔马利地区城市绿地转型的政治生态学：条件、驱动因素与权力关系
title_secondary: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations
authors: Abdulai Abdul-Hamid, Asiama Kwabena Obeng, Frank Gyamfi-Yeboah, Ibrahim Yakubu, Dogkubong Dinye Romanus
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) are critical for ecological sustainability, social wellbeing, public health, and urban livability, yet they are increasingly threatened in rapidly urbanising cities. This study employed a qualitative case study approach to examine the condition of urban green spaces and the socio-ecological and governance processes driving their decline in five communities within the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area (GTMA): Gumbehene, Nyohini, Kukuo, Taha, and Sagnarigu. Data were collected through in-depth semi-structured interviews with residents, community leaders, planning officials, landowners, and other stakeholders involved in land governance, complemented by field observations of green space distribution, quality, accessibility, and use. The data were analysed thematically through systematic coding and categorisation of interview transcripts and field notes to identify recurring patterns, key drivers, and governance challenges associated with green space decline. The findings reveal significant deterioration of UGSs, characterised by inadequate provision, poor maintenance, safety concerns, and increasing inaccessibility. This decline is driven by interconnected factors, including rapid population growth and horizontal urban expansion into green and open spaces, the commercialisation of customary land, weak planning enforcement, fragmented institutional responsibilities, and political interference. Together, these processes prioritise short-term economic and political interests over long-term ecological sustainability and community wellbeing, resulting in inequitable access to green spaces and the gradual erosion of their ecological, social, and public health functions. By foregrounding local perspectives and lived experiences, the study offers actionable insights for promoting sustainable, resilient, and inclusive urban planning and green space governance in the GTMA and other rapidly urbanising contexts facing similar challenges.

title: Forest livelihood strategies under contrasting management regimes: Evidence from the Copperbelt, Eastern and North-Western Provinces of Zambia
title_zh: 不同管理机制下的森林生计策略：来自赞比亚铜带省、东部省和西北省的证据
title_primary: 不同管理机制下的森林生计策略：来自赞比亚铜带省、东部省和西北省的证据
title_secondary: Forest livelihood strategies under contrasting management regimes: Evidence from the Copperbelt, Eastern and North-Western Provinces of Zambia
authors: Moses Kazungu, Sven Günter, Gillian Kabwe
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。

title: Shaking the Traditional Order: Women's Conversion to New Christian Churches in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撼动传统秩序：撒哈拉以南非洲女性皈依新基督教教会研究
title_primary: 撼动传统秩序：撒哈拉以南非洲女性皈依新基督教教会研究
title_secondary: Shaking the Traditional Order: Women's Conversion to New Christian Churches in Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Alvarez Aragon, Pablo, Guirkinger, Catherine, Platteau, Jean-Philippe
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, women constitute the majority of new Christian membership (including Evangelical and Pentecostal denominations), and this gender gap exceeds that of any other religion. Existing explanations for conversion to these churches emphasize demand for mutual help or informal insurance. We instead show that emancipation is central: these churches provide services that support women's economic advancement and help them challenge patriarchal norms. Using experimental data from Benin, we find that women randomly offered an economic opportunity become more likely to convert, partly because these churches help counter witchcraft threats, a risk that disproportionately targets economically successful women. To assess external validity, we combine large African datasets with local variation in exposure to positive economic shocks - using exogenous changes in cash crop prices and the implementation of world bank projects with a gender focus. Women are more likely to join new Christian churches following such shocks, especially where witchcraft beliefs are widespread. There, women work more, have fewer children, and exercise greater decisionâ€‘making power, while both women and men reject traditional beliefs, rituals, and authorities.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性构成了新兴基督教教会（包括福音派和五旬节派）新信徒的主体，这一性别差距超过任何其他宗教。现有对改信这些教会的解释强调对互助或非正式保险的需求。然而，我们证明解放是核心因素：这些教会提供支持女性经济进步并帮助她们挑战父权规范的服务。利用贝宁的实验数据，我们发现，随机获得经济机会的女性更可能改信，部分原因在于这些教会帮助对抗巫术威胁——这种风险不成比例地针对经济成功的女性。为评估外部有效性，我们将大型非洲数据集与正向经济冲击的局部暴露变化相结合——利用经济作物价格的外生变化以及以性别为重点的世界银行项目的实施。女性在经历此类冲击后更可能加入新兴基督教教会，尤其是在巫术信仰普遍的地区。在那里，女性工作更多、生育更少、拥有更大的决策权，同时女性和男性都摒弃传统信仰、仪式和权威。

authors: Kevin Zielnicki, Guy Aridor, Aurélien Bibaut, Allen Tran, Winston Chou 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Personalized recommendation systems shape much of user choice online, yet their targeted nature makes separating out the value of recommendation and the underlying goods challenging. We build a discrete-choice model that embeds recommendation-induced utility, low-rank heterogeneity, and flexible state dependence and apply the model to viewership data at Netflix. We identify recommendation-induced engagement from observational variation in algorithmic exposure, treating exposure as conditionally exogenous given observed user, good, and state characteristics. Separately, we estimate model-free diversion ratios from a randomized experiment that perturbs recommendations and use these to assess the validity of the structural model. We use the model to evaluate counterfactuals that quantify the incremental engagement generated by personalized recommendations. First, we show that replacing the current recommender system with a matrix factorization or popularity-based algorithm would lead to a 4% and 12% reduction in engagement, respectively, and decreased consumption diversity. Second, most of the consumption increase from recommendations comes from effective targeting, not mechanical exposure, with the largest gains for mid-popularity goods (as opposed to broadly appealing or very niche goods).

abstract: We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, , the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times . When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by . Unlike prior measures, is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.

abstract: This paper studies tax policy interaction among local governments for both mobile and immobile tax bases. We exploit exogenous changes in the local tax setting of German municipalities due to participation in state debt reduction programs to learn about the size, scope and nature of strategic interaction among local governments. Our results suggest strong and significant tax policy responses both in corporate as well as in property tax rates. Based on these results, the tax response function gradients are in the range of 0.30 to 0.69, depending on the tax instrument and state. Spatial, political, demographic, and administrative municipality characteristics all influence the size of the tax response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了地方政府在流动与非流动税基上的税收政策互动。我们利用德国市政当局因参与州债务削减计划而导致的本地税收设置外生变化，来探究地方政府间战略互动的规模、范围及性质。研究结果显示，企业所得税率和财产税率均存在显著且强烈的税收政策反应。基于这些结果，税收反应函数的斜率介于0.30至0.69之间，具体取决于税收工具及所在州。空间、政治、人口及行政市政特征均对税收反应的大小产生影响。

abstract: This paper develops a competitive search model with asymmetric information and argues that small firms hold liquid assets not only to self-finance their investments but also to signal their investment quality, thereby obtaining better loan terms. Because self-finance is an outside option of borrowing, it affects bank loans and the credit market structure. Monetary policy affects the cost of self-finance and hence affects the market structure and the screening regimes in the credit market. An increase in the policy rate can trigger banks to use screening contracts, which distort allocations. Using U.S. data, I document that dispersion in firms’ cash-to-asset ratios is hump-shaped in policy rates, consistent with the model’s prediction that firms use liquidity holdings to signal.

abstract: Mounting causal evidence shows particulate matter pollution reduces real-time cognitive function and increases aggressive behavior by reducing neural connectivity through oxidative stress and neuro-inflammation. We investigate a setting in which reduced cognition can generate significant private and external costs: driving. Using exogenous variation in wind direction, we show that a one-unit increase in PM 2.5 exposure results in just under a one-percent increase in fatal car crashes and fatalities. Further, these effects are limited to same-day pollution exposure, highlighting the immediate negative effects of high-pollution days. An across-the-board one standard deviation reduction in fine particulate matter pollution would have averted nearly 2000 motor vehicle fatalities in 2019.

authors: simiao song, Guanghui Cui
official: 官方在线 2025-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the effect of the Green Credit Interest Subsidy Policy (GCISP) on corporate green innovation. Drawing on a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2023, it employs a staggered difference-in-differences methodology. The findings reveal that the implementation of the GCISP led to a 7.67% increase in total green patent applications and an 11.81% rise in green invention patent applications, relative to the respective sample means. Notably, the policy’s effect is particularly salient among high-pollution enterprises in contrast to their less-polluting counterparts. Mechanism analyses further demonstrate that the GCISP stimulates green innovation primarily through reducing agency costs and alleviating financing constraints. The policy’s positive influence is most evident in regions characterized by stricter environmental regulations, and stronger intellectual property protection. Collectively, these findings provide robust evidence of the GCISP’s efficacy in facilitating corporate green innovation and yield important implications for the design and optimization of environmental policy frameworks in emerging market economies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了绿色信贷贴息政策（GCISP）对企业绿色创新的影响。基于2007至2023年中国A股上市公司样本，采用交错双重差分法进行分析。研究发现，GCISP的实施使绿色专利申请总量较样本均值增加7.67%，绿色发明专利申请量提升11.81%。值得注意的是，该政策对高污染企业的促进效应显著强于低污染企业。机制分析表明，GCISP主要通过降低代理成本与缓解融资约束来驱动绿色创新。在环境规制更严格、知识产权保护更强的地区，政策正向效应尤为突出。综合而言，这些发现为GCISP促进企业绿色创新的有效性提供了有力证据，并对新兴市场经济体环境政策框架的设计与优化具有重要启示。

title: Are China’s green stocks the safe haven? Evidence from geopolitical risks and oil prices
title_zh: 中国绿色股票是避险资产吗？来自地缘政治风险与油价的证据
title_primary: 中国绿色股票是避险资产吗？来自地缘政治风险与油价的证据
title_secondary: Are China’s green stocks the safe haven? Evidence from geopolitical risks and oil prices
authors: Yulu Yan Jinghao Li Cheng Li School of Economics and Management, Tiangong University, Tianjin, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the safe haven properties of China’s green stocks under geopolitical risks and oil market volatility. Leveraging an integrated analytical framework – including the Transformer-DCC-GARCH, SVAR, and TVP-VAR models – we examine the dynamic relationships among green stocks, geopolitical risks, and oil prices. The results show that green stocks exhibit a significant negative correlation with oil prices during periods of heightened geopolitical risks, such as the global oil price collapse, COVID-19 pandemic, and Russia-Ukraine conflict, indicating their short-term dynamic safe haven properties. Moreover, green stocks help stabilize oil price fluctuations by promoting energy transition, thereby indirectly mitigating the adverse impact of geopolitical risks and exhibiting long-term structural safe haven properties. These safe haven properties are time-varying and more pronounced during periods of heightened global risk. Further analysis demonstrates that incorporating green stocks into energy investment portfolios through a geopolitical risk-based strategy improves both return and risk-adjusted performance, confirming their practical hedging value. Overall, the findings suggest that while green stocks play a vital role in stabilizing energy markets, their hedging effectiveness is contingent on evolving risk environments. Strengthening regulatory support and expanding green financial instruments are essential to fully realize their safe haven properties.
abstract_zh: 本文探究中国绿色股票在地缘政治风险与石油市场波动下的避险属性。通过整合Transformer-DCC-GARCH、SVAR与TVP-VAR模型构建分析框架，我们考察了绿色股票、地缘政治风险与石油价格之间的动态关系。研究结果表明：在全球油价暴跌、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突等地缘政治风险加剧时期，绿色股票与石油价格呈现显著负相关，表明其具有短期动态避险属性。此外，绿色股票通过推动能源转型有助于稳定油价波动，从而间接缓解地缘政治风险的不利影响，展现出长期结构性避险属性。这些避险属性具有时变性，在全球风险加剧时期更为显著。进一步分析表明，基于地缘政治风险策略将绿色股票纳入能源投资组合，能够同时提升收益与风险调整后绩效，证实了其实际对冲价值。总体而言，研究结果表明绿色股票在稳定能源市场方面发挥重要作用，但其对冲效果取决于风险环境的演变。为充分实现其避险属性，需加强监管支持并拓展绿色金融工具。

official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the role of heterogenous preferences at the spousal level and that of spousal mutual insurance against wage shocks for couples’ labor supply in a time-use model. We estimate the model for couples in the German Time-Use Survey with Bayesian techniques and generate gender-specific wage-elasticities of market hours in the cross-section and for all couples. Missing mutual insurance ignores males’ behavior which we find to be substantial. Together with preference heterogeneity it shapes the elasticities’ size and distribution, especially for high and low hours worked and wage groups. Our setting is suitable to analyze nonlinear and distributional economic policy.
abstract_zh: 本文在时间利用模型中研究了配偶层面异质性偏好以及配偶间工资冲击相互保险对夫妻劳动供给的作用。我们采用贝叶斯方法，基于德国时间利用调查数据对模型进行估计，并生成了截面层面及所有夫妻的性别特异性市场工时工资弹性。缺失相互保险会忽略男性的行为，而我们的研究发现这种行为影响显著。与偏好异质性共同作用，这种缺失塑造了弹性的大小与分布，尤其在高、低工时及工资群体中表现突出。我们的研究框架适用于分析非线性及分布性经济政策。
